title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
lineage: AUD: reel master > CDR > EAC > CDR, 46:19
source: recorded by Marty Weinberg on a 5" Uher open-reel deck.

ai_review.summary: A notoriously weak soundboard source that strips away the concert’s atmosphere, even though the performance shines with a strong Phil and Jerry showing.
ai_review.review: The three fan reviews agree that this recording suffers from serious technical flaws – wobble, muffled ambience and an overall “worst source” rating for the show.  Despite the poor audio, reviewers who experienced the concert praise the band’s playing, calling it a Phil and Jerry tour‑de‑force and noting the unusual inclusion of "Mama Tried" in the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is praised (high rating) while recording quality is heavily criticized (low rating); weighted average yields a mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers cite technical flaws, wobble, and loss of atmosphere; described as the worst source for this show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; only a note that "Mama Tried" was performed, which some found noteworthy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised as part of a Phil and Jerry tour‑de‑force; his playing highlighted positively.
band_member_comments.Phil: Also praised within the same tour‑de‑force comment.
